text:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.shadow_count > threshold in eu-west-1 — page @oncall-anna @mike-sre
oncall-anna: I'm on it. Pulling recent counts and deployment history.
mike-sre: Reallocating SRE to help, pinging infra to check emitter proxy.
sam-eng: Saw a spike in emitter retries around 02:03 UTC, possible double-counting loop.
	tail of logs:
	```
	{"tenant":"acct-12X","emitter":"proxy-01","tokens_ingested":120430,"tokens_reported":98540}
	```

oncall-anna: Querying aggregator: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_ledger WHERE window=\'1m\' AND region=\'eu-west-1\';`
tara-support: Customer impact: a handful of accounts saw overage flags; suppressing alerts now.
evan-product: Notified PMs for top affected customers and opened a temporary support banner.
sam-eng: Hotfix plan: revert proxy-side debounced retry change, re-run dedupe backfill job `backfill-2026-03-20-01`.
oncall-anna: Running rollback now: `deploy rollback proxy-01 --to=revision-5f4b` — ETA 6m.
mike-sre: Starting backfill watcher. Will hold overage notifications until backfill completes or we confirm counts.
incident-bot: Update: rollback succeeded at 1805554370, emissions rate normalized.
oncall-anna: Confirmed token counts converging. Suppressed overage flags cleared for impacted CIDs. Scheduling postmortem.
mike-sre: Actions: (1) rollback, (2) backfill job triggered, (3) suppress flags + customer comms. Assigning action owners.
evan-product: Draft sent to support channel for affected customers. Will follow up with estimated remediation window.
oncall-anna: Closing pager -> moving to incident-review channel. Thanks all :thumbsup:
